lines.text: Hi Marek, you said on the phone it's your upper back this time?
Yeah, I'm coming in with a sharp pain between my shoulder blades when I breathe in deep.
I was carrying a sofa up three flights of stairs on Friday.
Okay. Let me have a look at your back.
Sorry to barge in, your half past three has phoned to say they're stuck in traffic.
Thanks Jen, tell them not to worry.
There's a tender joint on the right side at the level of your shoulder blades, and your ribs move fine when you breathe.
I'm going to mobilise that joint now, then we'll book you back in.
Right, I can see you again on Thursday at ten.
Er, no, sorry, Thursday at half past two, I've got a meeting at ten.
Keep breathing deeply every hour or so, even if it catches, so the ribs keep moving.
Will that stop it catching when I sneeze?
It should ease over the next week or so, and a pillow hugged to your chest helps when you sneeze.
